name: project-context-reader
description: A read-only MCP plugin for local Codex tasks to inspect selected local projects on demand.

interface.shortDescription: Select and read a local project for planning.
interface.longDescription: A read-only MCP server with session-only project selection, repository overview, code search, file excerpts, and Git context.
defaultPrompt: Use Project Context Reader to select my project, inspect it, and propose an implementation plan. Do not modify files.
